name: Canadian Phosphate
summary: Canadian Phosphate Limited provides regenerative phosphate and organic fertilizer solutions to markets across Australia and North America. The company's offerings further extend to fused calcium magnesium silica phosphate products. It maintains key interests in two rock phosphate mining ventures located in British Columbia, Canada: the Wapiti project, spanning approximately 78 square kilometers, and the Fernie project, covering an area of around 108 square kilometers. Established in 2010, the entity operated as Fertoz Limited before adopting its current name, Canadian Phosphate Limited, in February 2025. Its corporate headquarters are situated in Perth, Australia.
